answer:
Here is what I would bring up, most important first.

1. Hydrochlorothiazide may still be on your list when it should not be. You were hospitalized in March 2026 with a sodium of 123 and a fall, and the hospital stopped hydrochlorothiazide as the likely cause. But your pharmacy and clinic lists still show it as active, and your May eye-clinic medication list says you are taking it. Your June sodium was low again (134), and the June clinic note says to continue current medications. Please ask exactly what you are taking, make sure the stop was recorded, and ask whether your blood pressure plan needs adjusting. Your blood pressure was 128/80 in June.

2. A lung nodule found by chance has not been followed up. The CT you had for the kidney stone in October 2025 showed a 7 mm solid nodule in the right lower lung. The radiologist recommended a chest CT in 6 to 12 months, which means by about October 2026, so it is due now. I see no chest CT or any mention of the nodule in your later records. You have never smoked, which lowers the risk, but the follow-up scan is still recommended.

3. The repeat thyroid test is missing. In March 2026 your TSH was high (7.9) with a normal free T4. The hospital asked for TSH and free T4 to be repeated in 6 to 8 weeks. I find no repeat. Your June labs did not include one.

4. Cholesterol with diabetes. In September 2025 your LDL was 142 and HDL 48. You have type 2 diabetes and high blood pressure, and you are over 40, so a statin is generally recommended. I see no statin and no repeat lipid panel. Ask about both.

5. Diabetes checks. Your A1c has improved from 6.9 to 6.7 to 6.6, and your eye exam in May 2026 was clear. I see no urine albumin test (kidney screening) or foot exam in your records. Ask for both.

6. Kidney stone. The October 2025 emergency visit advised follow-up with your primary doctor in a week, or urology if the stone had not passed. Your urine also showed blood. I see no record that the stone passed or that anyone followed up. Ask whether it needs a check.

7. Vaccines and screening. Your last flu shot was 8 November 2025, so this season's shot is due. I see no COVID vaccine record. I also see no mammogram or cervical screening in these records. They may have been done elsewhere, so check. Your colonoscopy in 2019 was normal, and the next one is due around 2029.

8. Records to tidy. Lisinopril is listed as an allergy because of cough, which is really an intolerance. An older hospital export still lists lisinopril as active, but it was stopped in September 2025.

I can only see what is in these records. Anything done elsewhere would not show up here.
short: Hydrochlorothiazide was stopped for dangerously low sodium in March 2026 but still shows as active, and sodium was low again in June. A 7 mm lung nodule from October 2025 has had no follow-up chest CT. The repeat thyroid test (TSH high at 7.9) was never done. LDL was 142 with diabetes and no statin.
